adoptedNote: Your channel was carried over from another Twitch module ({fields}). What you type in the settings always wins.
forgotten: Carried-over channel forgotten. Only the setting of this page counts now.
err_auth: Twitch needs your permission: click “Connect my Twitch channel”.
err_rate: Twitch is limiting requests for now: nothing to do, we try again in a few minutes.
err_network: Twitch is not answering right now: nothing to do, we try again automatically.
err_config_affiliate: Subscriptions are only available to Twitch affiliates and partners.
err_config_credentials: First set up your Twitch application in the Twitch connector (once for all your Twitch modules).
conn_why: To count your followers and paying subscribers, Twitch first has to ask for your consent. It takes a minute, once.
reconnect: Twitch is asking for your permission again: click “Connect my Twitch channel”.
morePermission: You added a number to follow: click “Connect my Twitch channel” so Twitch allows it.
disconnected: Channel disconnected: Twitch can no longer be read with this permission.
disconnectedOffline: Channel disconnected here, but Twitch could not be told. To be sure, remove the access in Twitch (Settings, then Connections).
needHttps: Your site's address must start with https:// for Twitch to accept the connection.
chooseOne: Tick at least one number to follow (followers or paying subscribers), then save.
res_denied: You declined the permission at Twitch. Click “Connect my Twitch channel” again, then “Authorize”.
res_refused: Twitch refused the connection. Check your Twitch application in the Twitch connector (ID, secret and redirect address), then try again.
res_network: Twitch is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_rate: Twitch is limiting requests for now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_expired: The connection link had expired (10 minutes). Click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
res_wrongAccount: You signed in at Twitch with the account “{login}”, which is not this channel's. Sign in again with the right Twitch account.
res_scope: A permission is missing at Twitch. Try again and leave every box ticked.
cb_invalid: This connection link is no longer valid. Go back to your site's administration and click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
stat_hours_watched: Time watched by your viewers, in minutes (30 days)
stat_followers_gained: Followers gained during your lives (30 days)
live_honest: Measured by your site every {minutes} minutes while you are live, from the day this tracking was switched on: Twitch does not provide the history.
live_starting: Tracking has just been switched on: your site regularly checks whether you are live. Nothing is measured yet.
live_trouble: Twitch is not answering right now. Your site will try again by itself; no figure is made up in the meantime.
live_none: No live measured yet. Your next live will show up here.
live_bestTitle: The game that makes you gain the most followers
live_bestNone: Not enough lives yet to compare your games: at least 1 hour live on a game is needed.
live_needConnect: To count the followers gained per game, connect your Twitch channel (higher on this page).
live_videosNone: No video found on your channel.
live_videosError: The views of your videos are not available right now. They will come back by themselves.
live_videosStale: Twitch is not answering at the moment: these views are the last known ones.
live_eraseInfo: The detail of each measurement is kept {days} days; the summary of each live is kept much longer (adjustable in advanced mode). Erasing is final: tracking starts again from zero.
live_eraseConfirm: Erase all the measurements of your lives? This is final.
live_erased: Measurements erased. Tracking starts again from zero.
live_videosPending: The views of your videos will arrive in a few minutes.
conn_why_chat: For your chat bot to read the messages and answer them, Twitch must first ask for your consent. It takes a minute, once.
extras_note: This permission is also used by your chat bot: reading the chat messages and answering them.
notReadyConnector: Your Twitch application is missing: open the Twitch connector and follow its guide (5 minutes, once). The button will then appear here.
noConnector: My Twitch channel now goes through a connector to talk to Twitch. Without it, your channel's button and link stay visible, but nothing is read from Twitch (live, clips, figures).
suggestReason: connects your site to Twitch (live, clips, figures of your channel)
handover_conflict: This channel used another Twitch application than the Twitch connector's. Click “Connect my Twitch channel” below: the connector's application will be used, and the permission given to the other application will be removed by itself.
handover_incomplete: Your Twitch application could not be carried over completely (the ID or the secret is missing). Open the Twitch connector and complete it: nothing else to do here.
cb_noConnector: The Twitch connector is not installed: install it from your site's administration, then click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
cb_down: Your site could not finish the connection. Go back to the administration and click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
connectorMissing: The Twitch connector is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
